summary: Verified full removal of the 2-yıllık Freelancer visa (visa_freelancer_2y) across backend and frontend. All 7 requested checks pass. Fixed one leftover reference in /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml (static file still linked to the freelancer slug at /sitemap.xml). No console errors, no broken images on regression pages.

minor.issue: Returns 404. The site serves /sitemap.xml as a static file from frontend public/. Not a regression from this change, but a naming inconsistency worth noting.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/visa_guides.py still mentions 'freelancer/oturum vizesi' twice in prose text (lines 103 and 279) as alternative-plan hints. Since the freelancer product is discontinued, consider rewording these customer-facing paragraphs to avoid confusing users.

Static /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml is manually maintained and duplicates data owned by the backend visa_guides/visa_types. Consider having the sitemap generated from the backend catalogue to avoid future drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Freelancer visa cleanup verified end-to-end. GET /api/visa-types returns 8 items (no freelancer). GET /api/visa-guides has 8 items (no freelancer). GET /api/visa-guides/2-yillik-freelancer-vizesi -> 404. Admin /api/admin/visa-types returns 10 entries with visa_14_single and visa_freelancer_2y both active=false. Admin UI /admin/vize-tipleri still renders the freelancer card with 'Sitede yayında' toggle OFF as intended. Frontend home marquee, /vize-tipleri (all 4 tabs), /basvuru type list, and /dubai-vizesi/2-yillik-freelancer-vizesi (shows not-found) all clean. No broken images anywhere (Unsplash office image replacement works). Note: /api/sitemap.xml is 404 (backend does not serve sitemap); /sitemap.xml is served as static from frontend/public — I removed the freelancer <url> block from it in this run.
rca of the issue: Static sitemap.xml under frontend/public was manually maintained and had not been updated when visa_freelancer_2y was removed from backend content. Removed the freelancer <url> entry.
